title: KS-229: Close the 2026-06-10 assurance umbrella tracker, or keep it open?
bluf: KS-229 is the umbrella tracker for the 2026-06-10 assurance review; its only PR (#785, encryptedField header fix) merged 2026-09-10 and the ticket says it has no deliverable of its own. Children KS-239, KS-263 and KS-760 sit in the backlog (per triage; the ticket text does not list them all). The GitHub integration repeatedly walked it to In Review, which is noise. Your earlier rulings on this ticket were about SECURITY.md and CODEOWNERS, not about closing it. Board-only effect.

sources.quote: Umbrella tracker for the 2026-06-10 assurance review
KS-229 is the 2026-06-10 platform assurance tracker; this PR corrects one item under it
the integration transitions on an identifier appearing in a branch name or PR body
tracker: two items need your input

options.label: Keep open as the umbrella (children stay in backlog)
options.detail: No change. Tracker keeps showing the review's open set.

options.label: Close the tracker; children stay as standalone backlog tickets (board-only)
options.detail: Cleaner board; the review write-up remains in the vault. Reopenable.

default_action: After 48 h nothing changes: the tracker stays open (option a). Safest and reversible.
